role: Characterization XCTest suite for RRCollector's observable surface: ArchiveSignal coalesced version bumps, back-compat forwarding to DeviceStatus/StreamingLifecycle/MorningCoordination/SessionState sub-observables, resetSession, MorningProcessingStatus equality, ANS config and paused-session lookup.
types: RRCollectorObservableStateTests: class — @MainActor XCTestCase over RRCollector sub-observables
state: collector: lazy var RRCollector() — built on first access via the shared-dependency convenience init
cancellables: Set<AnyCancellable> (reset in setUp/tearDown, never used by any test)
toplevel: lazy collector property defers RRCollector() construction until first use so setUp's clearPersistedState runs first; cancellables is declared and cleared but no test subscribes anything.

flags.text: The lazy `collector` is RRCollector() which wires the app host's shared SettingsManager, SessionArchive and CloudKitSyncManager (AppDependencies.current); the ANS tests write settingsManager.settings (vo2MaxOverride, useHealthKitVO2Max, enableTrainingLoadIntegration) on that shared manager and only restore them in defer, and setUp/tearDown wipe the real persisted-recording UserDefaults keys, so the suite shares and mutates app-host state.

units.does: Clears persisted recording state: PersistedRecordingState.clear() plus removal of the three legacy RRCollector.activeRecording* UserDefaults keys.

flags.text: Lines 24-26 remove the three legacy RRCollector.activeRecording* keys that PersistedRecordingState.clear() already removes via clearLegacy() (same string values in UserDefaultsKeys); clear() also wipes the real RRCollector.dismissedInterruptedSessionIds set of the app host, so every setUp/tearDown erases the user-visible interrupted-session dismissals in the host app's standard defaults.
